build_RPNHead: build an RPN head instance with a given number of input channels and keyword arguments
create_RPNHead_init_layers: create and initialize the RPN conv, classification, and regression convolutional layers
run_RPNHead_forward_single: run a forward pass on a single scale feature map to get cls scores and bbox predictions
test_RPNHead_loss: test the RPN head loss computation using cls scores, bbox preds, and ground truth bboxes
review_RPNHead_get_bboxes_single: review the _get_bboxes_single method that transforms cls scores and bbox preds into NMS-filtered proposals
